name: zcode-discipline
description: Discipline hooks: goal-round cap with re-grounding, edit read-back verification with stop-veto, session DB backups. All state under ~/.zcode/discipline-state.

maxRounds.title: Max rounds per session
maxRounds.description: Prompts before every tool call is denied and the agent must report. /discipline-reset lifts the cap.

warnAt.title: Warn at round
warnAt.description: Round where re-grounding nudges start. Kept below max rounds automatically.

stopGate.title: Stop gate
stopGate.description: off = never veto stops; soft = veto only if a proof command is set; hard = veto any unverified edit

verifyCommand.title: Proof command
verifyCommand.description: Command that proves the work works, e.g. npm test. Empty = no proof required.

backupKeep.title: DB backups to keep
backupKeep.description: How many session-DB snapshots to retain (one taken per session start).

backupMaxMB.title: Skip backup above (MB)
backupMaxMB.description: Skip the snapshot if the session DB is bigger than this.
